title: Laundromat
kidsText: Twenty washing machines near a college. Quarters come in all day and night.
adultText: Twenty machines in a strip mall next to a college. Open all night, no employees, quarters every day.

title: Eight-Unit Apartment Building
kidsText: Eight apartments, all rented out. The rent pays the loan and then some.
adultText: Brick building, full occupancy, a property manager already in place. Rent covers the mortgage with room to spare.

title: Forty Acres Outside Town
kidsText: Empty land near town. It costs a little each month, but someone may want it later.
adultText: Farmland the city is growing toward. It earns nothing today and costs taxes, but a developer may come calling.

title: Car Wash
kidsText: A car wash on a busy corner. A manager runs it for you.
adultText: Automatic tunnel wash on a busy corner. A manager runs it; you check the numbers once a month.

title: Fourplex Near the Hospital
kidsText: Four homes in one building. Nurses and doctors rent them.
adultText: Four two-bedroom units a block from the regional hospital. Medical staff keep it full year-round.

title: Six-Unit Brick Walkup
kidsText: Six apartments in an old brick building. The rent pays the loan.
adultText: Three floors, six units, original hardwood. Rents are a little low, and the building is in good shape.

title: Twelve-Unit Apartment Complex
kidsText: Twelve apartments with a manager. Lots of rent every month.
adultText: Two buildings, twelve units, a manager on site, and a parking lot. A real business with real paperwork.

title: Mobile Home Park
kidsText: Forty spots where people park their homes. They pay you rent for the land.
adultText: Forty lots with water and power hookups. Residents own their homes and rent the land, so repairs are rare.

title: Three Rental Houses
kidsText: Three houses in different parts of town, all rented out.
adultText: A retiring landlord sells three single-family rentals as a package. Three tenants means one vacancy never sinks you.

title: Lake Cabin Rental
kidsText: A cabin by the lake. Families rent it for vacations.
adultText: Three bedrooms on the water, booked online by the week. Summer pays for the year; a cleaning crew handles turnovers.

title: Small Office Building
kidsText: A building with offices. Businesses pay you rent.
adultText: Two stories, five tenants: an insurance agent, a dentist, and three small firms. Longer leases than apartments.

title: Strip Mall with Four Shops
kidsText: Four stores in a row. Each store pays you rent.
adultText: A pizza place, a nail salon, a tax office, and a phone store. If one leaves, the other three carry the loan.

title: Medical Office Condo
kidsText: An office a doctor rents from you. Doctors stay a long time.
adultText: One suite in a medical office park, leased to a family practice for ten years. Boring and reliable.

title: Sandwich Shop Franchise
kidsText: A sandwich shop with a famous name. A manager runs it.
adultText: A franchise location with a proven menu and a manager in place. Royalties eat some profit; the brand brings the crowd.

title: Self-Storage Units
kidsText: Rooms people rent to store their stuff. Lots of small rents add up.
adultText: One hundred twenty climate-controlled units behind a gate. Few repairs, no tenants calling at midnight.

title: Child Care Center
kidsText: A place where little kids play and learn while parents work.
adultText: A licensed center for sixty children with a waiting list. Staffing is the hard part; demand is not.

title: Auto Repair Shop
kidsText: A garage that fixes cars. Mechanics do the work, and you own it.
adultText: Four bays, three mechanics, and a loyal customer list. The owner is retiring and will train you for a month.

title: Coffee Shop
kidsText: A coffee shop on Main Street. Some months are great, some are slow.
adultText: A busy corner cafe with a good lease. Margins are thin, and a new chain across the street could hurt.

title: Landscaping Company
kidsText: Trucks and crews that mow and plant for many customers.
adultText: Two trucks, two crews, and a hundred contracts with homes and businesses. Plows snow in the winter.

title: Fitness Studio Franchise
kidsText: A gym with classes. Members pay every month.
adultText: A boutique studio with four hundred members. Monthly dues are steady until a cheaper gym opens nearby.

title: ATM Route
kidsText: Cash machines in stores. Each time someone uses one, you earn a fee.
adultText: Fifteen cash machines in convenience stores and bars. You keep part of every fee and refill them weekly.

title: RV and Boat Storage Lot
kidsText: A big fenced lot where people park campers and boats.
adultText: Four acres of gravel, a fence, and cameras near the lake. Owners pay monthly to park campers and boats.

title: Lots by the New Interchange
kidsText: Empty land near a new highway exit. It may be worth a lot later.
adultText: Three commercial lots by an interchange still under construction. Taxes cost you now; a gas station chain may call later.

title: Timberland Tract
kidsText: A forest you own. The trees grow, and the land may be worth more later.
adultText: Eighty acres of pine planted fifteen years ago. Taxes cost a little now; the trees and the land both grow in value.

title: Jumbo CD
kidsText: Lock up a big pile of money at the bank. It grows every month.
adultText: A large-balance certificate with a better rate. Ten thousand minimum, insured, and it pays you every month.
